If $\sin \theta = \frac{3}{5}$, then $O = 3$, $H = 5$. By Pythagoras, $A = \sqrt{25 - 9} = 4$. So $\cos \theta = \frac{4}{5}$ and $\tan \theta = \frac{3}{4}$.
Since $\sin \theta = \frac{O}{H}$ and the hypotenuse is always the longest side, $O < H$, so $\frac{O}{H} < 1$.
